name: Jade Harley
source:
A friend of John, Rose, and Dave. Jade lives alone on an island with just her dog, Bec. The player befriends her in Volume 4 of Pesterquest.

Jade is an energetic, but somewhat forgetful young girl with an interest in gardening. She seems to have prophetic dreams.
